core_obligations: Handle the G-ring case via Artin approximation and completion flatness.
Step I: prove the statement is independent of the versal ring via faithful flatness and the two flatness-permanence lemmas.
Step II: reduce along finite field extensions, using Step I for choice-independence.
Step III: reduce to a completed local ring of a smooth scheme via etale closed point and two field extensions, close by composition of flat morphisms.
proof_roadmap: G-ring case + choice-independence + field-extension reduction + scheme reduction
difficulty_reason: Three-step reduction fully executed: the G-ring case via the accepted Artin-approximation lemma and flatness of completion; Step I proves choice-independence of the versal ring (formally smooth map, faithful flatness, composition-flat and flat-permanence lemmas); Step II reduces along finite field extensions using the (rejected-as-card but externally carried) versal-ring-field-extension and Step I; Step III reduces to the completion case via a smooth surjection U -> X, a finite type point on the fibre (algebraic space), an etale surjection to a closed point, finiteness of the two field extensions (named section), applying Step II twice, and closing with completion-flat plus smooth-flat plus composition. Every step carries a named basis; no omissions.
